During the [[Desolator crisis]], a [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi Knight]] was sent on a '''mission''' to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] in order to destroy the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] known as the [[Death Mark laser]]. Along with the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[T7-O1]], the Knight's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Kira Carsen]], and the Knight's former master [[Orgus Din]], the Jedi was able to locate and destroy the weapon, despite subterfuge perpetrated by an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] double-agent by the name of [[Aleyna Hark]]. Tracking the weapon's control center to the base of Lord [[Nefarid]], one of the apprentices of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Angral]]&mdash;the instigator of the crisis&mdash;the Knight was able to [[Battle in Nefarid's hideout|defeat]] the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and target the Death Mark's central computer with the weapon itself, but [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] Din was [[Death/Legends|killed]] attempting to sneak aboard Angral's flagship, the [[Oppressor (Harrower-class)|''Oppressor'']].
